prompt.name: Commandement en zone contaminée
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished 2D/2.5D fighting-game character sprite, ONE full body only, isolated on a truly transparent background. Single static neutral-ready pose facing screen RIGHT, three-quarter side view, head and feet both visible, feet on one common ground baseline. Portrait composition, complete silhouette with at least 5 percent transparent margin all round. Match the refined hand-painted game-sprite style and identity of the first standing figure in the reference, not the whole atlas. Clean solid outlines, precise material shading, readable anatomy and equipment attachments. Do not make a sprite sheet, pose variations, multiple characters, comparison layout, text, captions, UI, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, glow or atmospheric haze. The requested clothes are an original CQC costume, not an official released-game outfit. Preserve the same period-specific character and do not borrow another incarnation. MERYL SILVERBURGH in her Metal Gear Solid 4 Rat Patrol incarnation, original costume “Commandement en zone contaminée”. Preserve her mature adult face, athletic muscular physique, short shoulder-length reddish-brown swept hair and dark headband exactly in the reference identity; do not turn her into MGS1 Meryl. Retain recognizable dark green shirt, tan Rat Patrol tactical chest rig and holstered handgun accessible at her thigh. Add a purposeful charcoal-grey and olive protective oversmock, reinforced cuffs and a lowered respirator at her neck with two deliberately asymmetric compact replaceable filter housings, short tidy breathing hose and belt filter cartridge pack. Face remains fully visible; gloves, tan cargo trousers and knee pads retain practical military construction. Small established arm-tattoo placement can show where clothing allows, no invented giant logos. Weathered contaminated-zone materials, no ragged cloak and no gas-mask face obscuring identity. One full-body right-facing neutral ready stance.

visualReview.description: MGS4 Rat Patrol adult identity with protective oversmock and asymmetric respirator equipment.
visualReview.note: Physically viewed: adult MGS4 Meryl face/hair, asymmetrical respirator housings lowered near neck, protective oversmock, accessible holster and knee pads.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC design; no claim of official outfit or exact recovered historical pixels. Anchor is preliminary and may be refined in catalogue QA.
